<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>OTTO — Atendente Inteligente para Imobiliárias</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;0,700;1,300;1,400&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --black: #070809;
    --navy: #0f1c2e;
    --navy-mid: #1B2A4A;
    --gold: #C9A96E;
    --gold-light: #e2c99a;
    --gold-dark: #9a7a48;
    --white: #f5f0e8;
    --white-dim: rgba(245,240,232,0.7);
    --white-faint: rgba(245,240,232,0.12);
  }

  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

  body {
    background: var(--black);
    color: var(--white);
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 300;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  /* ── NAVBAR ── */
  nav {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    z-index: 100;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 20px 60px;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(7,8,9,0.95), transparent);
    backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
  }

  nav .nav-logo img {
    height: 40px;
    filter: brightness(1.1);
  }

  nav .nav-links {
    display: flex;
    gap: 40px;
    list-style: none;
  }

  nav .nav-links a {
    color: var(--white-dim);
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 13px;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: color 0.3s;
  }

  nav .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--gold); }

  nav .nav-cta {
    background: var(--gold);
    color: var(--black);
    border: none;
    padding: 10px 28px;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background 0.3s, transform 0.2s;
  }

  nav .nav-cta:hover {
    background: var(--gold-light);
    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }

  /* ── HERO ── */
  #hero {
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .hero-left {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 140px 60px 80px 60px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
  }

  .hero-eyebrow {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 32px;
  }

  .hero-eyebrow span {
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.25em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
  }

  .hero-eyebrow::before {
    content: '';
    display: block;
    width: 32px;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--gold);
  }

  .hero-title {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(52px, 6vw, 86px);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.05;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }

  .hero-title em {
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--gold);
  }

  .hero-subtitle {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.7;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    max-width: 420px;
    margin-bottom: 52px;
  }

  .hero-actions {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 32px;
  }

  .btn-primary {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    background: var(--gold);
    color: var(--black);
    text-decoration: none;
    padding: 16px 36px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: all 0.3s;
  }

  .btn-primary:hover {
    background: var(--gold-light);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(201,169,110,0.3);
  }

  .btn-secondary {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    text-decoration: none;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(245,240,232,0.25);
    padding-bottom: 2px;
    transition: color 0.3s, border-color 0.3s;
  }

  .btn-secondary:hover {
    color: var(--gold);
    border-color: var(--gold);
  }

  .hero-right {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .hero-right::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--black) 0%, transparent 30%),
                linear-gradient(to top, var(--black) 0%, transparent 20%);
    z-index: 2;
  }

  .hero-right img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: center top;
    opacity: 0.85;
  }

  .hero-badge {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 48px;
    left: -20px;
    z-index: 3;
    background: rgba(15,28,46,0.9);
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,169,110,0.3);
    padding: 16px 24px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    animation: float 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  @keyframes float {
    0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
    50% { transform: translateY(-8px); }
  }

  .hero-badge .badge-num {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 36px;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: var(--gold);
    display: block;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .hero-badge .badge-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--white-dim);
  }

  /* Gold line decorator */
  .gold-line {
    width: 48px;
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--gold), transparent);
    margin-bottom: 40px;
  }

  /* ── SECTION BASE ── */
  section {
    padding: 100px 60px;
  }

  .section-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.25em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .section-label::before {
    content: '';
    display: block;
    width: 24px;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--gold);
  }

  .section-title {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(36px, 4vw, 56px);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.15;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  .section-title em {
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--gold);
  }

  /* ── STATS BAR ── */
  #stats {
    padding: 48px 60px;
    background: var(--navy);
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(201,169,110,0.15);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(201,169,110,0.15);
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 20px;
  }

  .stat-item {
    text-align: center;
  }

  .stat-num {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 48px;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: var(--gold);
    line-height: 1;
    display: block;
  }

  .stat-label {
    font-size: 12px;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    margin-top: 6px;
    display: block;
  }

  .stat-divider {
    width: 1px;
    height: 60px;
    background: rgba(201,169,110,0.2);
  }

  /* ── COMO FUNCIONA ── */
  #como-funciona {
    background: var(--black);
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .pipeline-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 1px;
    background: rgba(201,169,110,0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,169,110,0.1);
    margin-top: 60px;
  }

  .pipeline-step {
    background: var(--black);
    padding: 32px 28px;
    position: relative;
    transition: background 0.3s;
  }

  .pipeline-step:hover {
    background: var(--navy);
  }

  .step-num {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 48px;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: rgba(201,169,110,0.2);
    line-height: 1;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .step-title {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--white);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }

  .step-desc {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  /* ── FEATURES ── */
  #funcionalidades {
    background: var(--navy);
  }

  .features-container {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .features-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 32px;
    margin-top: 60px;
  }

  .feature-card {
    background: rgba(7,8,9,0.6);
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,169,110,0.12);
    padding: 36px 32px;
    transition: border-color 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
  }

  .feature-card:hover {
    border-color: rgba(201,169,110,0.4);
    transform: translateY(-4px);
  }

  .feature-icon {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border: 1px solid var(--gold);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    color: var(--gold);
    font-size: 18px;
  }

  .feature-title {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 400;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    color: var(--white);
  }

  .feature-list {
    list-style: none;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 9px;
  }

  .feature-list li {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    padding-left: 16px;
    position: relative;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .feature-list li::before {
    content: '—';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    color: var(--gold-dark);
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  /* ── PLANOS ── */
  #planos {
    background: var(--black);
  }

  .plans-container {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .billing-toggle {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
    margin-top: 40px;
    margin-bottom: 60px;
  }

  .toggle-label {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  }

  .toggle-label.active {
    color: var(--gold);
  }

  .toggle-switch {
    position: relative;
    width: 52px;
    height: 28px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .toggle-switch input {
    opacity: 0;
    width: 0;
    height: 0;
  }

  .toggle-track {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: var(--navy-mid);
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,169,110,0.3);
    transition: 0.3s;
  }

  .toggle-switch input:checked + .toggle-track {
    background: rgba(201,169,110,0.2);
    border-color: var(--gold);
  }

  .toggle-thumb {
    position: absolute;
    top: 4px;
    left: 4px;
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    background: var(--gold);
    transition: 0.3s;
  }

  .toggle-switch input:checked ~ .toggle-thumb {
    transform: translateX(24px);
  }

  .toggle-badge {
    background: rgba(201,169,110,0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,169,110,0.3);
    color: var(--gold);
    font-size: 11px;
    padding: 3px 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .plans-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 2px;
    background: rgba(201,169,110,0.08);
  }

  .plan-card {
    background: var(--black);
    padding: 48px 36px;
    position: relative;
    transition: background 0.3s;
  }

  .plan-card.featured {
    background: var(--navy);
  }

  .plan-card.featured::before {
    content: 'MAIS POPULAR';
    position: absolute;
    top: -1px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    background: var(--gold);
    color: var(--black);
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    padding: 5px 20px;
  }

  .plan-name {
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.25em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .plan-title {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 32px;
    font-weight: 300;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    color: var(--white);
  }

  .plan-price {
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .plan-price .amount {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 52px;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: var(--gold);
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .plan-price .currency {
    font-size: 20px;
    color: var(--gold);
    vertical-align: super;
    margin-right: 4px;
  }

  .plan-price .period {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    margin-left: 4px;
  }

  .plan-billing-note {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--gold-dark);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    min-height: 18px;
  }

  .plan-setup {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    margin-bottom: 32px;
    padding-bottom: 32px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(201,169,110,0.12);
  }

  .plan-features {
    list-style: none;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 40px;
    flex: 1;
  }

  .plan-features li {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 10px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .plan-features li .check {
    color: var(--gold);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: 2px;
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  .plan-features li .cross {
    color: rgba(245,240,232,0.2);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: 2px;
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  .plan-features li.disabled {
    color: rgba(245,240,232,0.25);
  }

  .plan-btn {
    display: block;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 14px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .plan-btn-outline {
    border: 1px solid rgba(201,169,110,0.4);
    color: var(--gold);
    background: transparent;
  }

  .plan-btn-outline:hover {
    border-color: var(--gold);
    background: rgba(201,169,110,0.08);
  }

  .plan-btn-solid {
    background: var(--gold);
    color: var(--black);
  }

  .plan-btn-solid:hover {
    background: var(--gold-light);
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(201,169,110,0.3);
  }

  /* ── LGPD / SEGURANÇA ── */
  #seguranca {
    background: var(--navy);
    padding: 80px 60px;
  }

  .security-grid {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 48px auto 0;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
    gap: 1px;
    background: rgba(201,169,110,0.1);
  }

  .security-item {
    background: var(--navy);
    padding: 32px 24px;
    text-align: center;
    transition: background 0.3s;
  }

  .security-item:hover { background: var(--navy-mid); }

  .security-icon {
    font-size: 24px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    color: var(--gold);
  }

  .security-label {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    line-height: 1.5;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }

  /* ── CTA FINAL ── */
  #cta {
    background: var(--black);
    padding: 120px 60px;
    text-align: center;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  #cta::before {
    content: 'OTTO';
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 280px;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: rgba(201,169,110,0.04);
    white-space: nowrap;
    pointer-events: none;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  }

  #cta .cta-content {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    max-width: 640px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  #cta .cta-title {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(40px, 5vw, 64px);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.1;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  #cta .cta-subtitle {
    font-size: 15px;
    color: var(--white-dim);
    line-height: 1.7;
    margin-bottom: 48px;
  }

  .whatsapp-btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    background: #25D366;
    color: #fff;
    text-decoration: none;
    padding: 18px 44px;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  }

  .whatsapp-btn:hover {
    background: #1ebe5a;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(37,211,102,0.3);
  }

  .whatsapp-btn svg {
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;
    fill: white;
  }

  /* ── FOOTER ── */
  footer {
    background: var(--navy);
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(201,169,110,0.12);
    padding: 40px 60px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }

  footer .footer-logo img {
    height: 32px;
    opacity: 0.7;
  }

  footer .footer-copy {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(245,240,232,0.35);
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }

  footer .footer-links {
    display: flex;
    gap: 24px;
  }

  footer .footer-links a {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(245,240,232,0.35);
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.3s;
  }

  footer .footer-links a:hover { color: var(--gold); }

  /* ── ANIMATIONS ── */
  @keyframes fadeInUp {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }

  .fade-in { animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease forwards; }
  .fade-in-2 { animation: fadeInUp 0.8s 0.2s ease forwards; opacity: 0; }
  .fade-in-3 { animation: fadeInUp 0.8s 0.4s ease forwards; opacity: 0; }
  .fade-in-4 { animation: fadeInUp 0.8s 0.6s ease forwards; opacity: 0; }

  /* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    nav { padding: 16px 24px; }
    nav .nav-links { display: none; }
    section { padding: 60px 24px; }
    #hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .hero-right { height: 50vh; }
    .hero-left { padding: 120px 24px 48px; }
    #stats { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 32px; padding: 40px 24px; }
    .stat-divider { display: none; }
    .pipeline-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .features-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .plans-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .security-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    footer { flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; text-align: center; }
    .hero-badge { left: 16px; bottom: 16px; }
    nav .nav-cta { padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 11px; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- NAV -->
<nav>
  <div class="nav-logo">
    <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="OTTO">
  </div>
  <ul class="nav-links">
    <li><a href="#como-funciona">Como Funciona</a></li>
    <li><a href="#funcionalidades">Funcionalidades</a></li>
    <li><a href="#planos">Planos</a></li>
  </ul>
  <a href="https://wa.me/5511963798901?text=Ol%C3%A1%2C+quero+conhecer+o+OTTO" target="_blank" class="nav-cta">Falar com a ValérIA</a>
</nav>

<!-- HERO -->
<section id="hero">
  <div class="hero-left">
    <div class="hero-eyebrow fade-in">
      <span>Agente Inteligente para Imobiliárias</span>
    </div>
    <h1 class="hero-title fade-in-2">
      O atendente que<br><em>nunca</em> para de<br>trabalhar.
    </h1>
    <p class="hero-subtitle fade-in-3">
      O OTTO atende leads 24h via WhatsApp, qualifica perfis, envia fotos, transcreve áudios, agenda visitas e notifica corretores — sem intervenção humana.
    </p>
    <div class="hero-actions fade-in-4">

<script>
  // Billing toggle
  const prices = {
    one:   { monthly: 450, annual: 360 },
    pro:   { monthly: 750, annual: 600 },
    prime: { monthly: 1200, annual: 960 }
  };

  function toggleBilling() {
    const isAnnual = document.getElementById('billing-toggle').checked;
    
    document.getElementById('label-mensal').classList.toggle('active', !isAnnual);
    document.getElementById('label-anual').classList.toggle('active', isAnnual);

    ['one', 'pro', 'prime'].forEach(plan => {
      const price = isAnnual ? prices[plan].annual : prices[plan].monthly;
      document.getElementById('price-' + plan).textContent = price.toLocaleString('pt-BR');
      document.getElementById('note-' + plan).textContent = isAnnual
        ? `Equivalente a R$ ${(prices[plan].annual * 12).toLocaleString('pt-BR')}/ano — economize R$ ${((prices[plan].monthly - prices[plan].annual) * 12).toLocaleString('pt-BR')}`
        : '';
    });
  }

  // Scroll reveal
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.style.opacity = '1';
        entry.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });

  document.querySelectorAll('.pipeline-step, .feature-card, .plan-card, .security-item').forEach(el => {
    el.style.opacity = '0';
    el.style.transform = 'translateY(20px)';
    el.style.transition = 'opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease';
    observer.observe(el);
  });
</script>
